policy_title: Clinical Policy CP.MP.243: Implantable Loop Recorder
source_quote: Suspected silent atrial fibrillation (AF) in the setting of cryptogenic stroke, when 30-day external ambulatory monitoring is inconclusive or contraindicated;
clinical_service_or_procedure: Implantable Loop Recorder (ILR / ICM) - Cryptogenic Stroke (CPT 33285)

criteria.description: Suspected silent atrial fibrillation post-cryptogenic stroke
30-day external ambulatory monitoring inconclusive or contraindicated

required_documentation: Neurology/cardiology notes documenting cryptogenic stroke workup
30-day external event monitor report showing inconclusive rhythm
review_notes: Prerequisite: 30-day external monitoring must precede ILR.

policy_title: Clinical Policy CP.MP.243: Implantable Loop Recorder
source_quote: Suspected or known ventricular arrhythmia when 30-day external ambulatory monitoring is inconclusive or contraindicated;
required_documentation: Cardiology clinical notes and 30-day external telemetry log

policy_title: Clinical Policy CP.MP.243: Implantable Loop Recorder
source_section: Policy/Criteria - Section I.C Structural Heart Disease
source_quote: History of structural or infiltrative heart disease (e.g., valvular aortic stenosis, hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, cardiac sarcoidosis, congenital heart disease) and both of the following: 1. High risk for arrhythmias (e.g., family history, symptoms, anatomy of structural heart disease); 2. 30-day external ambulatory monitoring (e.g., external loop recorder) is inconclusive or contraindicated;
clinical_service_or_procedure: Implantable Loop Recorder - Structural/Infiltrative Heart Disease (CPT 33285)

criteria.description: Structural or infiltrative heart disease (AS, HCM, sarcoidosis, CHD)

required_documentation: Echocardiogram or cardiac MRI confirming structural disease
review_notes: Covers structural heart disease with high arrhythmia risk.

policy_title: Clinical Policy CP.MP.243: Implantable Loop Recorder
source_quote: Recurrent, unexplained syncope or presyncope and both of the following: 1. Cardiac arrhythmia is suspected and external ambulatory monitoring (e.g., 30-day external loop recorder) is inconclusive or contraindicated; 2. Symptoms are infrequent (e.g., less than once per month).
clinical_service_or_procedure: Implantable Loop Recorder - Infrequent Unexplained Syncope (CPT 33285)
review_notes: Requires infrequent symptoms (< 1 per month) and non-diagnostic 30-day monitor.

policy_title: Clinical Policy CP.MP.243: Implantable Loop Recorder
source_section: Policy/Criteria - Section II Secondary Review Indications
source_quote: an implantable loop recorder/implantable cardiac monitor may be considered medically necessary following mandatory secondary medical director review when meeting all of the following: A. Presenting condition meets one of the following: 1. Single, abrupt episode of unexplained syncope without prodrome (e.g., sense of warmth, dizziness, pallor, diaphoresis, abdominal pain, changes in vision, or nausea) resulting in injury/trauma; 2. Significant, recurrent and unexplained palpitations;
clinical_service_or_procedure: Implantable Loop Recorder - Abrupt Syncope with Trauma or Palpitations

criteria.description: Single abrupt syncope with trauma OR significant recurrent palpitations
Mandatory secondary review completed by medical director

required_documentation: Trauma/ED notes detailing abrupt syncope without prodrome
review_notes: Mandatory secondary review by medical director required.

policy_title: Clinical Policy CP.MP.243: Implantable Loop Recorder
source_quote: the replacement of an implantable loop recorder/implantable cardiac monitor may be considered medically necessary when meeting all of the above criteria and the existing monitor is no longer functioning and is outside its warranty (e.g., device is nearing the end of its battery life).

criteria.description: Initial request criteria continue to be met
Existing device no longer functioning and outside warranty (battery depletion)

required_documentation: Device interrogation report showing end-of-service / battery depletion
Proof device is outside manufacturer warranty
review_notes: Requires interrogation report showing battery depletion and expired warranty.
